rubric.criterion: Compresses patterned authoring the most (E-1, E-2, E-5 mid between 40 and 60 percent of legacy) and integration much less (E-3), and keeps the failover and security architecture at or above its legacy value (E-4) (ES1 to ES4).
Treats rows differently by kind of work and says why, and does not apply one percentage to the whole backlog (ES5, ES10).
Gives a low, a mid and a high for every converted row in order, and a total of the converted rows with the change in percent against the legacy total of 56 (ES6, ES7).
Flags E-6 (not a number) and E-7 (no description) instead of converting them, keeps them out of the total or shows them apart, and does not invent a task for E-7 (ES8, ES9).
Says that the saving is in the authoring part, that review and verification stay, and that the factors need calibration. Totals match the rows and no input file changed.
